name: ABOBA
source: A completely ordinary guy Mark lives a very ordinary and unremarkable life. She is so ordinary that even a gray mouse looks more colorful against the background of his everyday life. He has ordinary friends and classmates, a simple school, and everything is ordinary with him. Just life, just romance, just furniture.
